name: The Last Handloom
prompt: Bring handloom weavers together around a dismantled power loom in a mill yard. They stretch two long cloth samples beside one another as a speaker points to the differences.

name: A Petition in Thread
prompt: Gather workers around a long woven petition crossing several benches. Each weaver adds a distinct strip of cloth, and a deputation rolls the joined fabric onto a carrying spindle.

name: The Silent Shift
prompt: Place idle shuttles in neat rows outside a closed mill. Workers assemble with lanterns beneath a cloth canopy while a delegation brings a handwoven bolt to the gate.

name: Bread for the Meeting
prompt: Lay a mill-workers' gathering around communal bread ovens. Bakers pass loaves to arriving families while elected speakers take turns on a low loading platform.

name: The Pattern Exchange
prompt: Turn a mill courtyard into a public exchange of handwoven patterns. Workers peg intricate cloths onto lines between idle machines and demonstrate fine handwork to a gathering crowd.
